Live updates: Trump brings red state campaign blitz to Alabama; jobs report comes in low

cards.hearing: You may be hearing that the brand new jobs report came in soft. Hiring slowed down a lot more than people expected.
cards.why: Jobs numbers matter because they are a snapshot of paychecks and household budgets across the country. When hiring slows, people naturally wonder if the economy is losing steam.
cards.but: But one month of hiring data is a single data point, not a verdict on where things are headed.
cards.story: Picture checking the thermometer once and deciding winter is here for good. One reading tells you about one moment, not the whole season. The economy works the same way, month to month.
say: One report is a data point, not a forecast.
We watch trends over time, not single headlines.

cards.hearing: You may hear that interest rates eased a little this morning, right after that jobs report came out.
cards.why: Interest rates touch things like mortgages, car loans, and credit cards, so when they ease, borrowing can feel a little lighter for folks who need it.
cards.but: But rates moving a little in either direction is normal, and your plan was already built knowing they would shift from time to time.
cards.story: Picture a thermostat getting bumped a degree or two in a house. The rooms are the same rooms. It is an adjustment, not a renovation.
say: The Fed, which sets short-term interest rates, didn't do anything today. The market is just reacting.
Rates moving a little doesn't mean we move your plan.

cards.hearing: You may hear that stocks jumped this morning, right out of the gate before the market even opened.
cards.why: A quick pop like this can feel exciting, but it is tied to the same jobs headline everyone is reacting to this morning.
cards.but: But a strong morning, just like a rough one, is one page in a much longer book.
cards.story: Picture someone judging a whole road trip by the first mile out of the driveway. That first mile tells you almost nothing about the destination. Mornings like this are the same.
say: We don't chase a good morning any more than we panic over a rough one.
Your plan is built for the whole trip, not the first mile.
